methodology: Four fresh Node processes. Per fixture/session: twelve discarded warmup pairs and one hundred measured fresh-state pairs; deterministically randomized AB/BA order within each pair. Each timed operation creates new graph state, creates history event empty-before/committed-after, and appends to fresh history. Input clone outside timer. Same process, machine, fixture and operation within each pair; no forced GC. Exact uninstrumented production modules. Median upper central order statistic; p95 nearest rank. A baseline; B candidate. No UI/paint included.
